title: 2026학년도 겨울 GNU 영어캠프 원어민강사 모집(Recruiting GNU English Camp Instructor)
body:
Gyeongsang National University English Camp

Description

Gyeongsang National University in Jinju is currently seeking applicants for its Winter English Camp. The camp runs from January 10th to January 21st 2027. There is a mandatory orientation day for teachers on January 9th. Elementary School students from around the area around Jinju will participate in a variety of events where they will use English in practical ways. The camp is designed to increase English-speaking confidence and motivation through active participation in themed events.

Candidate Qualifications

Experience teaching young learners in Korea

Native English Speaker with a University degree

Passport from one of the following countries: Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, South Africa, UK, USA.

All F visa holders are welcomed

No E-2 visa holders will be accepted

Currently living in Korea with a valid visa

Working Conditions

Dates

Mandatory Orientation on January 9th, 2027

Camp begins January 10th, 2027

Camp ends January 21st, 2027

Teacher Responsibilities

Teachers might be required to create some materials to supplement camp materials

Teachers will be tasked with classroom and activity management

Teachers will be asked to write student reports.

Schedule

Daily meetings at 8:30 am in the Teacher’s Office

Approximately 8 classes daily

Classes 40-50 minutes followed by a ten-minute break

1-hour break for lunch

1-hour break for dinner

We will work on the weekend

Room and Board

Teachers will be provided a dormitory room in our student dorms

Teachers will be provided breakfast, lunch, and dinner at the student cafeteria

Compensation

3 Million Won (before taxation) upon completion of contract

Required Documents to apply

Resume

Brief cover letter highlighting what makes you suitable for this camp (within body of email is fine)

Application and Document Submission

All required documents should be sent to the camp director at gnucamp@gmail.com
